policy.intro: Brute-force and port-scan detection for the box's own logins and ports. The thresholds, block times, allow-list and cap below are part of the configuration: save them to the candidate, then commit. The sources blocked right now are on the Blocked sources tab.
policy.readOnly: Your role cannot change the configuration.
policy.saved: Saved to the candidate. Commit to apply it.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.help: Master switch; when off no source is auto-blocked.

rules.title: Detectors
rules.help: One rule per source; a source with no rule is not watched.

source.title: Detector
source.help: Web login (web/API sign-in), SSH, VPN auth (IKE/EAP) or port scan (probes to the box).

threshold.title: Threshold
threshold.help: Failures (port scan: distinct ports) from one source within the window before it is blocked.

windowSec.title: Window (seconds)
windowSec.help: The sliding window the threshold is counted over.

blockSec.title: Block (seconds)
blockSec.help: How long a first offence is blocked.

escalate.title: Escalate on repeat
escalate.help: Double the block time on each repeat offence, up to the maximum block.

maxBlockSec.title: Maximum block (seconds)
maxBlockSec.help: The escalation cap; a single block never lasts longer than this.

allowlist.title: Allow list
allowlist.help: Addresses and networks that are never blocked: your management networks and your own address. Loopback is always allowed.

maxEntries.title: Maximum blocked entries
maxEntries.help: Cap on the live auto-block set; the soonest-to-expire entry is dropped when it is reached.
